Recent research warns that sampled-candidate metrics can change model ordering, rather than merely inflate scores. RecSys 2025 evaluates sampling reliability through resolution, fidelity, robustness and predictive power; 2024 work also demonstrates benefits from correcting sampled rank estimates. Keep the benchmark’s fixed 99-negative macro HR@10 as the selection objective, while reporting full-catalog validation ranking separately. Neither measures unbiased user preference when exposure is unknown. [Sampling reliability](https://doi.org/10.1145/3705328.3748086), [rank estimation](https://research.google/pubs/improved-estimation-of-ranks-for-learning-item-recommenders-with-negative-sampling/).

Recommended audit design: use positive-item rank percentiles, pairwise win rates and top-k overlap, which are invariant to strictly increasing score transformations, instead of raw margins. Slice results by training-history length and training-item frequency; report slice sizes. Normalize recommendation exposure against the eligible unseen catalog and compare with training-frequency baselines, explicitly treating frequency as a proxy rather than observed exposure. Bootstrap paired per-user performance differences within each category, then average category means equally; these intervals capture user-sampling uncertainty, not training-seed or adaptive-search uncertainty. These are proposed operational choices, consistent with literature emphasizing user/item subgroup evaluation. [Popularity-bias survey](https://link.springer.com/article/10.1007/s11257-024-09406-0).

For component attribution, compare intact histories with shuffled histories, truncated histories and an embedding-only pooling baseline; treat inference interventions as sensitivity evidence, not proof of training causality. Follow promising signals with controlled retraining that changes only the encoder, embedding treatment or negative sampler/loss. gSASRec links negative sampling to overconfidence, supporting loss/sampler controls before architectural expansion. Cache scores, bootstrap on CPU, and reserve GPU budget for paired interventions. Judge diagnostic usefulness by subsequent improvements in unchanged validation macro HR@10; twenty simulator users support descriptive audits only. [gSASRec](https://www.ijcai.org/proceedings/2024/939).
